issues.description: Path-shape mismatch between changedFiles and isIncluded's filename may silently exclude all files
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(_filename)) against this.changedFiles via strict includes(). VitestGit.findChangedFiles output format (absolute vs relative, casing, Windows slashes) may not match, silently producing empty coverage. Both sides need explicit normalization and a test for the absolute-vs-relative path case.

issues.description: globCache may retain stale entries computed before changedFiles was set
issues.detail: isIncluded writes to globCache regardless of changedFiles state. The clear() in onTestRunStart only helps if it runs before any isIncluded call; entries cached during config resolution, plugin setup, or earlier watch-mode passes can leak through as stale `included=true` values. Invalidate whenever changedFiles changes.

issues.description: Silent fallback when findChangedFiles returns null leaves coverage unfiltered
issues.detail: If VitestGit.findChangedFiles returns null (no git repo, bad ref, git failure), changedFiles becomes undefined and coverage silently reports all files — the opposite of user intent. CI users relying on coverage.changed could publish full coverage thinking it was filtered. Should warn or error rather than silently degrade.

issues.description: onTestRunStart hook timing and call-site coverage may leave changedFiles unset on some paths
issues.detail: The hook is awaited after _testRun.start in three core.ts call sites, but collectFiles, typechecker, browser-mode, and any pre-test coverage hooks may run isIncluded before changedFiles is populated. Either move resolution earlier (e.g. during _initialize) or audit every coverage-generating entry point.

issues.description: CLI transform has dead/dangerous branches and breaks branches literally named true/false
issues.detail: The transform accepts 'true'/'yes'/'false'/'no' and also checks `value === true/false` which are unreachable for string CLI input. A bare `--coverage.changed` may yield empty string or boolean depending on CAC parsing, neither handled cleanly. Branches literally named 'true' or 'false' cannot be used as git refs via CLI.

issues.description: Test file mode flipped to 0755 (executable) without justification
issues.detail: test/coverage-test/test/changed.test.ts had its mode changed from 100644 to 100755 with no shebang or reason. Almost certainly an accidental chmod from the contributor's environment; revert to 100644 to avoid noise in the tree.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the coverage.changed feature is useful and well-tested for the happy path, but flags several correctness and robustness concerns. The strongest consensus is around path-shape mismatch between VitestGit output and isIncluded's normalized filenames, which could silently yield empty coverage. Secondary concerns are globCache invalidation when changedFiles changes, silent fallback to full coverage on git failure, onTestRunStart hook timing and entry-point coverage, and CLI transform edge cases. An accidental executable bit on a test file is the one cosmetic cleanup.
